login.description: The Login that owns this resource.

forlogin.description:
The identifier of the Login that this Alert relates to. 
The Alert is triggered based on the activity of this Login.

team.description: The identifier (ID) of the team that this Alert relates to. The Alert is triggered based on the activity of this Team.

division.description: The division for which this Alerts applies.

partition.description: The partition for which this Alerts applies.

name.description:
The name of this Alert. 
This field is stored as a text string and must be between 1 and 100 characters long.

allOf.description:

<details>
<summary>Valid Values</summary>

- `0` - **Active**
- `1` - **Inactive**

</details>
